recipe.visualDefinition: A dimly lit, cluttered bedroom scene centered on a large cardboard box resting on a bed. The atmosphere is defined by warm incandescent string lights and a cool blue window light, creating a high-contrast, moody indoor environment filled with personal artifacts like polaroids and a guitar.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm interior glow versus cool exterior window light
Central cardboard box as the primary focal point
Cluttered foreground textiles framing the bottom edge
String lights creating a diagonal visual path across the background
coreInvariants: Hand-written marker text on the central box
Presence of warm, glowing light bulbs
Muted, slightly desaturated color palette with teal and orange tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large cardboard box occupies the center-middle ground, acting as the primary subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing light bulbs at the base of the box provide the strongest point of luminance.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central box, moves up to the top text, follows the string lights to the right, and settles on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image around the window and the dark corners of the room provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber/orange from the interior lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool teal/blue from the window and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neutral browns and greys from the box and bedding.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high local contrast around light sources; overall saturation is restrained to enhance the moody feel.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is a tall, narrow oval
The 'M' has a high middle junction
The 'S' has a gentle, elongated curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity across all text elements using the same hand-drawn style to maintain a cohesive 'personal' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Scribbled-out marker effect on the box

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tall, thin, hand-drawn essence.
Matches the elongated verticality and organic stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photograph of a cluttered bedroom at night. A large cardboard box sits on a messy bed in the center. Warm string lights are draped across the wall with polaroids. A window in the background shows a cool blue twilight. The lighting is moody with a teal and orange grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add tall, condensed, hand-drawn white uppercase text at the top and bottom center. On the cardboard box, add a black marker scribble and hand-written 'DO NOT OPEN' text in a casual marker style.

verificationChecks: Is the text elongated and hand-drawn?
Is the lighting a mix of warm amber and cool teal?
Is the central box the main focus?
Is the overall mood nostalgic and intimate?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue window light
Amount of text on the box
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text on the box looks like it was written with a real marker.
Check that the string lights have a realistic glow/bloom effect.
Verify the color balance maintains the teal/orange contrast.
Confirm the typography is legible but retains a 'sketchy' quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central mundane object (like a box) with intimate domestic clutter, lit by contrasting warm/cool light sources, and overlaid with tall, hand-drawn condensed typography.
